decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The D1 use hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of four calendar months from the date of this permission. If the use has not commenced within this period and no written application to extend this period has been received by the Council then the current permitted Class A1 use shall be the lawful use of both premises. The A1 use in the northern unit which is shown hatched on the 1:50 scale drawing numbered SKDental 02.X (received 06.03.2003) shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application, accompanying letter and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is first occupied and used).

Condition : 3 - The primary purpose of that part of the northern unit which is shown hatched on the 1:50 scale drawing numbered SKDental 02.X (received 06.03.2003) shall be only for purposes falling within Class A1 (retail) of  the Town & Country Planning (Use Class) Order 1987 (as amended). The use of the southern unit shall be as a Class D1 (Dentist Surgery) and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in the Class D Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.

Condition : 4 - The A1 and D1 class uses hereby permitted shall not be open to anyone other than staff outside the hours of 08.00-21.00 hours Monday-Friday and 09.00-18.00 hours on Saturdays, and not at all on Sundays and public holidays without the further written consent of the Local planning authority.
Condition : 5 - The thresholds of the two new units' shopfronts shall be level with the pavement outside and free from any raised obstacles.
description: Change of Use from A1 to A1 Retail and D1 Dental surgery and erection of new shopfront
